name: B10-0121/2025 (PPE) – Recent dismissals and arrests of mayors in Türkiye
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the recent dismissals and arrests of mayors in Türkiye
part_text:
The European Parliament is not changing any law here. It is stating its opinion and making requests. It condemns Türkiye for removing and jailing elected mayors and replacing them with appointed officials. It asks Türkiye to release the jailed mayors, give dismissed mayors their jobs back unless a court has proven wrongdoing, stop using terrorism laws against opponents, and fix its courts. It also asks the European Union to keep watching the situation and consider diplomatic steps.

- Türkiye is asked to release jailed mayors and reinstate dismissed ones; the mayors and their voters are affected.
- Türkiye is urged to stop misusing terrorism laws against politicians, activists and journalists.
- The European Union is asked to monitor Türkiye and take diplomatic measures; no deadline is set.
